entities.summary: The Joseph L. Rotman School of Management is the graduate business school of the University of Toronto, based on the St. George campus in downtown Toronto, Ontario, Canada. The university has offered undergraduate courses in commerce and management since 1901, however the business school was formally established in 1950. The school is named after Joseph L. Rotman, its principal benefactor.
